Spine fixtures: receipts emitted by each tool's own code, 2026-11-02.

Each file was written by the tool's reference implementation, imported from a
shallow clone of github.com/HarperZ9/<tool> at the commit below, with injected
clocks so the bytes replay. Nothing here was edited by hand after emission.

  emet      85e1c518  emet.witness_receipt.emit_receipt, from a verify envelope
                      emet-receipt-match.json (two subjects, MATCH)
                      emet-receipt-drift.json (one subject, DRIFT)
  crucible  82aacb24  crucible.assess.assess, from make_claim and make_thesis
                      crucible-assessment-warn.json (2 MATCH, 1 UNVERIFIABLE)
                      crucible-assessment-drift.json (1 DRIFT)
  gather    e7c55b97  gather.digest.digest_of_receipts, two receipts, one with
                      derived_from and a non-ASCII title
                      gather-digest.json

Files are written as json.dumps(obj, indent=2, sort_keys=True,
ensure_ascii=False) plus a newline, UTF-8. Every check in harness/spine works on
the parsed object, so the indentation carries no meaning.
